questions.q: Who said, "Your people will be my people"?
questions.evidence: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God

questions.q: What did Naomi ask to be called when she came back to Bethlehem?
In whose field did Ruth happen to glean?
questions.evidence: and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech

questions.q: What was the name of the son born to Ruth and Boaz?
